notes.title: Version 1.18 is live!
notes.content:
Hi there,
This is the first update after the Release! 
Big thanks to all of you who helped us by giving a detailed feedback and share a good opinion during the first days after the launch!

Here is the list of fixes and improvements in this version:

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]World Map: if current stone is not active Play button is disabled
[*]Small Chinese translation fixes
[*]On second map (0_02) in case of using 21:9 resolution You can find all hidden objects now
[*]Fixed bad field on map 3_04 (lava)
[*]Fixed bad fields on map 2_06 (dam)
[*]Map 3_06c has less solutions now (map state will be reset)
[*]Bug with resetting music volume to 100% when entering some levels is fixed
[*]Alf-F4 for exiting the game works now
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added WIP language slots for testing translation (Czech, French, Spanish)
[*]Space key and middle mouse button resets camera now
[/list]

These are not all fixes from feedback - rest will be soon!

[h1]Important note:[/h1]

We received a few messages that the scene in the game does not show (only fog is visible). Solution to this issue is:
1. in NVIDIA Control Panel - set anti-aliasing mode to application-controlled
2. and (in the case it not helps) upgrade NVIDIA drivers.

Best Regards!

[*]Alf-F4 for exiting the game works now

notes.title: Version 1.15 - with Chinese language!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

[h1]Chinese language support[/h1]
We have big news for players from China - Archaica supports Simplified Chinese now! Note: it's still WIP and not all texts are translated. Also - this language is not marked as supported yet on Steam page. You can select it in Archaica Launcher and it is also recognized automatically (from Steam settings).

Really big thanks to [b]Leon Wong[/b] for this translation!


[h1]And the list of game bugs fixed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]after returning to level (after solving it) camera will not move back and forward between the last two stages
[*]map 5_03 is corrected (invalid field was marked as valid)
[*]small audio rattle bugs fixes
[*]Primal Well now is rotating when activated
[*]UI glitch (for a moment) when entering to the Totem screen is fixed
[*]UI glitch (for a moment) when showing End Level screen is fixed
[*]audio options works instantly now (no need to leave options menu)
[/list]

Best Regards!

- UI glitch (for a moment) when entering to the Totem screen is fixed
- UI glitch (for a moment) when showing End Level screen is fixed

notes.title: Pre-release version 1.14
notes.content:
Hi
In this version, we fixed a few important things at the beginning of the game. Here is the list:

[h1]Game bugs fixed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]no shadows on Totem
[*]showing Totem with 'null' achievement after first round (sometimes)
[*]entering tutorial even if the Player selected 'No'
[*]hints from earlier stages are cleared now (in multi-stages levels)
[/list]

[h1]Known and still not resolved bugs:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Unfortunately this is still valid (and rare): sometimes game locks on incorrect camera in level making the game impossible to play - use RESET button from in-game popup menu in this case as a substitute solution.
[*]there is still possibility of placing devices in incorrect places
[/list]

Best Regards

After a bit long break the next part of improvements is ready! Here is the list:

[h1]Launcher bugs fixed:[/h1]
[list]

[list]

Unfortunately this is still valid: sometimes game locks on incorrect camera in level making the game impossible to play - use RESET button from in-game popup menu (added in this version) in this case as a substitute solution.[/h1]
[*]help texts for icons on the bottom of the screen (when playing a level for the second time)
[*]it is possible to take devices from different stages of the level
[/list]

Thanks for feedback!

Best Regards!
